name: Fake police: move money to a 'safe' account
contact_channel: phone call, sometimes followed by a video call
script_phrases: 口座が犯罪に使われている
victim_instructions: tell no one, including family and bank staff
give a cover story at the counter
cover_stories: 家族の買い物 (a family purchase)

name: Relative in trouble (オレオレ)
script_phrases: 会社のお金をなくした
victim_instructions: tell no one, especially the spouse
a colleague or boss will collect the cash

name: Gold bullion purchase
script_phrases: 金を買えば資産が守られる
業者が受け取りに行く
victim_instructions: hand the gold to a collector
payment_methods: cash to buy gold, then gold handover
